headline: In-line Q2 show with improved growth outlook

highlights: Bector Foods delivered a record revenue in Q2FY27 with sequentially stable margin.
While its revenue grew 14% y/y, EBITDA margin stood at 13.1%, in line with street estimate of 13%.
It expects FY27 revenue growth in mid-teens (H2 at mid-to-high teens), aided by price hikes in Oct-Nov, distribution expansion, premiumisation and recovery of deferred export orders.
With inflation peaking in Q3FY27, the management aims to sustain EBITDA margin at ~13.1% before improving to 13.5-14% in Q4FY27 and reiterated its 14-15% medium-term target.
valuation: With inflation peaking in Q3FY27, the management aims to sustain EBITDA margin at ~13.1% before improving to 13.5-14% in Q4FY27 and reiterated its 14-15% medium-term target.

Considering healthy earnings visibility and reasonable valuation, we retain BUY rating on the stock with a higher TP of Rs275 (from Rs250 earlier), valuing it at 35x Sep-28 EPS (vs. 35x FY28e EPS earlier).
Management Commentary: On distribution, the company added ~30k of its targeted 40k direct outlets in H1, taking the total to ~345k.
watch: Introducing our estimates for FY29e, we tweak our FY27/28e earnings estimate to factor in strong Q2 performance and growth outlook.
Outlook and Valuation: At CMP, the stock trades at 37/29/25x FY27/28/ 29e EPS of Rs5.7/7.2/8.5.
